summary_en: Correction to August 18, 2026 buyback program notice. Ex-treasury shares outstanding revised upward from 18,203,176 to 18,219,280; treasury holdings revised from 885,540 to 889,264 shares as of July 31, 2026. Original program terms remain unchanged.
title_en: (Correction) Partial Amendment to "Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Treasury Share Acquisition"
translation_en_brief: This is a correction notice to the buyback program announcement filed on August 18, 2026. The company identified an error in the reference data on treasury share holdings as of July 31, 2026. The ex-treasury shares outstanding figure was revised upward from 18,203,176 shares to 18,219,280 shares, and the treasury share count was adjusted from 885,540 shares to 889,264 shares. The original buyback program terms, limits, and execution details announced on August 18 remain unchanged; only the factual reference data for share counts has been corrected.
